appliedOperationIds.description: Ordered ids of the operations 1..stateIndex (length must equal stateIndex — invariant proposed_state_index_mismatch).

items.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

baselineRealityVersionId.description: The PINNED authoritative Reality-Graph version this proposed state branches from — a read-only reference; proposals never mutate observed reality.

contentDigest.description: sha-256 digest of the engine-materialized state content (PROD-022); the contract pins the digest form, not the materialization.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

epistemicStatus.description: ALWAYS 'PROPOSED' — the schema-level proposal-isolation seal: OBSERVED/INFERRED/CONFIRMED are unrepresentable inside a proposed state.

materializedAt.description: Engine clock instant of materialization; EXCLUDED from the state identity derivation (identity is content).

solutionId.description: The solution this state belongs to.

stateId.description: Deterministic proposed-state identity (deriveProposedStateId). The SAME identifier feeds the synchronized 3D, 2D and BOQ views of this proposal step.

stateIndex.description: Layer number: 0 = the baseline overlay; N = after operation N.

versionNumber.description: The solution version this state belongs to.
